status: proposal; no deployed ability or access expansion
compatibility: v1 remains site-only and returns one profile only when exactly one record is qualified; multiple profiles return profile=null. v2 selects exact normalized site_id/site_url + target tuple; never infers whole-site ownership or chooses another record. Existing mutation/inspection/migration shapes remain content-v1.
policy_catalog: Unique immutable site_id/site_url/target -> descriptor and trusted parity/runtime bindings. Distinct target records/fields may coexist on a site. v1 owner enrollment stays limited until v2 catalog exists.
service_owned_qualification: Ordinary staff may request an edit or inspect a target. Missing qualification is handled by protected platform service using centrally enrolled template/ownership rules and independently measured live/runtime inputs; no staff record/site enrollment, new logins, per-site tokens or per-person approval. Until qualified it returns profile=null and mutations fail closed.
registration_boundary: A future register-content-profile-v1 is control-plane only, never a delegated staff operation or advertised workspace tool. Require an independent protected registrar signature naming exact site/target/template eligibility/current owner policy and measured parity/runtime/profile/report hashes; one-use receipt and atomic catalog publication. A raw service credential or actor assertion cannot enroll a profile. No real-site activation is implemented by this proposal.
hashes: Split stable authorization-policy version from immutable per-target qualification digest so publishing an unrelated record profile does not invalidate every pending site operation; target profile replacement/revocation always invalidates its affected plans/QA. Role, issuer, customer, service pin or signer changes still invalidate grants globally.
limits: Bounded catalog and lookup; exact ID+stable selector, no aliases or wildcard matching. Each operation retains an immutable selected profile and remeasures parity under its target locks. Source ownership and independent live rendering checks remain mandatory.

followups.acf: Existing public record + owner-qualified ACF field key/name/reference/type. Start scalar text/textarea/URL/email/integer/boolean/select. Read effective definition and exact value/reference; CAS complete declared field/reference and rendering dependencies; update_field only; explicit sanitization/type bounds. No arbitrary post_custom, repeats, flexible content or builder writes.
followups.menu: Existing exact menu/term/item IDs and stable item identity. Start label and validated URL/target/rel only. Inspect full typed item/relationship snapshot; transaction CAS; fixed native wp_update_nav_menu_item; independent affected navigation paths and rollback. No create/delete/reorder without later qualification.
followups.media: Existing attachment + owner-qualified title/caption/alt metadata only. Preserve MIME/original file/dimensions/parent/link ownership and filesystem identity. CAS full typed attachment/meta snapshot; native WordPress update; affected display and rollback. File import/replacement/derivatives remain separate with reviewed MainWP File Uploader transport and explicit checksums/registration/rollback.
